title: Policies and regulations
content: Bennett University's Office of the Registrar publishes academic rules and regulations, ordinances and university policies. The current registrar page lists items including the B.Tech academic rules, internship policy, placement policy, refund policy for AY 2026-27, grievance redressal mechanism, student discipline and conduct rules, IT policy, sports policy, anti-ragging policy and standing orders for hostel and library.
